description: This file contains integration tests for the Delete functionality of Articles in a web application. It includes test cases for deleting articles normally, deleting articles with tags, and deleting articles with comments.

classes.name: DeleteTests
classes.description: A test class that covers the delete operations for articles, including deletion of articles with associated tags and comments.

methods.name: Expect_Delete_Article
methods.description: Tests that an article can be deleted successfully.

methods.name: Expect_Delete_Article_With_Tags
methods.description: Tests deletion of an article that has associated tags.

methods.name: Expect_Delete_Article_With_Comments
methods.description: Tests deletion of an article that has associated comments.
